scope: Speaker silent since kernel r15 era; investigation (unresolved)
symptom: PipeWire playback runs (PCM RUNNING, hw_ptr advancing), every DAPM widget on the speaker path is on, MCLK (RPM div_clk1) enabled, speaker boost GPIO60 high, codec registers read live equal the cache and match the stock Firefox OS playback dump on the speaker driver, yet the owner hears nothing; no kernel errors
what_worked_before: r14 installed (2026-11-01 morning, right after the stock capture): owner heard clean tones at 100% PipeWire volume

heard: r14 kernel + r19 DTB without the framebuffer node (RAM)
r19 kernel + DTB with framebuffer node holding only the power domain (RAM, first try)
silent: r19 kernel + DTB without IMU vdd-supply (RAM)
r20 installed (framebuffer power domain only) x2
r20 DT + PMIC GPIO8 (BOOST_BYP) driven low like stock (RAM)

conclusion: not a single DT or kernel change: the same kernel and identical DTB were heard once and silent in later boots; the failure looks per-boot intermittent with a low success rate since the r14 day. Ruled out: stale ALSA controls, PipeWire (direct ALSA plays fail differently: S16 AFE start error 1), SLIMbus QMI timeout (present in every boot), MCLK/clock tree, IMU LVS1 supply, framebuffer clocks (r20 dropped them; harmless), PMIC GPIO8 alone, phone position
side_findings: direct S16 playback to hw:0,0 fails: AFE port start returns DSP error 1 (port 0x4000); PipeWire uses S24 and starts fine
the RX3 digital gain default came from an idle stock snapshot (-24 dB); stock plays at 0 dB
the boot-restored ALSA state sets RX3 to 0 dB
next: an objective detector (record the speaker with the phone's microphone once the TX path works, or an external recording) so owner listening is not the only signal
compare a full codec/ifc/PMIC/TLMM state capture from an audible boot against the silent captures in local/audio-bisect/state-*.txt
check for an analog/connector fault by booting stock once
kernel_r20: fx0-linux integration/fx0-fb-pd-only: framebuffer node keeps only the MDSS power domain (7 of 7 hold-free boots clean); installed

update_mic.kernel: r21 (fx0-linux integration/fx0-mic): main microphone capture works (MultiMedia2 <- SLIMBUS_0_TX <- SLIM TX1/TX2 <- DEC1 <- ADC1, MIC BIAS1/LDO_H); owner voice at 30 cm reaches -45 dBFS
update_mic.speaker_measured: a 1 kHz tone at full codec gain reaches the mic at -52 dBFS (amplitude) on every play, scales 1:1 with RX3 gain, disappears with the SPK DAC off, and drops 20 dB when the owner covers the rear grille: the speaker plays acoustically but roughly 30 dB too quietly to hear
update_mic.earlier_silent_plays: script artifacts (missing /tmp files after reboot, chained commands), not real intermittency
update_mic.stock_path: stock DAPM during playback powers SPK DAC/PA and, from RX3 via RDAC5=DEM3_INV, LINEOUT2 DAC/PA with CDC_CP_VDD (VDD_BUCK S4 + buck helper L25)
update_mic.r22: fx0-linux integration/fx0-lineout2: LINEOUT2 path with the stock class-H line-out sequence and S4/L25 supplies; resulting buck/NCP registers equal stock; mic shows no acoustic contribution from LINEOUT2 (alone: nothing; with SPK: unchanged -52 dBFS)
update_mic.r24: fx0-linux integration/fx0-be-s24 + integration/fx0-rxsb-format: SLIMbus back ends pinned to S24_LE (the ADSP rejects 16-bit SLIMbus starts; PipeWire's 16-bit UCM probe then dropped the card profile and left only a dummy sink) and the codec RX port sample format programmed per stream width (was stuck at 16-bit); PipeWire speaker sink restored, no AFE errors; speaker level unchanged, owner still hears nothing
remaining_hypotheses: a further analog setting stock applies outside the registers compared (stock dumps were all taken mid-playback; idle values unknown)
the external speaker boost/amp needs more than GPIO60 (no further GPIO found in the stock DT or machine driver)
compare against stock with the same microphone method: boot stock once and record the stock speaker with a second device, or capture stock's full PMIC/TLMM pin state during playback
